title: Al-Mughni
author: ibn-qudama
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Ibn Qudama's encyclopaedic treatment of Hanbali law, arranged by book from purification and prayer through transactions, marriage, inheritance and penalties. It records the positions of the other schools before arguing the Hanbali one, and is the largest of the classical comparative fiqh works.
historicalContext: Written in Damascus by the Hanbali jurist Ibn Qudama, whose family had migrated from Palestine. The work became a foundation of the Hanbali school and a standard reference for comparative legal reasoning.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
